description: Historical, offline-serving Candidate TP3 recipe for the GLM 5.2 NVFP4/AQLM hybrid vision checkpoint. It is unsupported on Vonk's current one- or two-Spark configuration: a two-rank split alone would require at least 146.3 GB of checkpoint bytes per Spark before KV cache or runtime overhead, above the roughly 126.9 GB-per-node inventory. The executable contract remains installable for a future three-Spark canary; glm-5-3-flash-exl3-dflash2-vllm-dual is the current 126 GB-admission-envelope GLM alternative. GB10 memory correction: GPU utilization 0.895 → 0.85. Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint. This deviates from the upstream memory profile to avoid unified-memory thrashing; context, the explicit KV-cache byte limit and other kit flags are retained; the GPU utilization budget is reduced. Absolute KV correction: 14,152,454,784 bytes per rank covers 1 simultaneous full-context requests at 230,256 tokens using the pinned cache-geometry allocation bound. Context is capped from the creator profile's 348,160 tokens to 230,256 so selected weights, this KV pool and 8 GB runtime overhead remain admissible on an idle Spark; full creator context with this concurrency does not fit. This is an offline estimate; physical acceptance remains pending.
title: GLM 5.2 AQLM three Sparks
